claim: The Windows ZIP package can be extracted into the user's Programs directory, launched there, replaced in place without deleting user data, and removed while leaving that data intact.

verification.detail: The hosted job passed Verify Windows ZIP install, replacement, and removal using python scripts/test_desktop_archive_install.py apps/or_app/build/windows/x64/runner/Debug. The helper created and extracted the ZIP, installed under %LOCALAPPDATA%\\Programs, launched with build-only environment overrides removed and only the app and Windows system paths available, replaced the app from a fresh extraction, and verified user-data preservation and app removal.

limitations: This tests the ZIP's manual per-user placement and replacement path with the same build payload; it does not establish an OS-native installer, registry integration, or version-differential updater.
The launch smoke check establishes the installed app remains alive for its timeout, not interactive usability or performance.
Signing and production release readiness are not established.
